title: Senior UI/UX Designer (Web & eCommerce) - Strong AI design experience

We are looking for an experienced designer who combines strong design judgement with practical experience using AI to deliver high-quality work efficiently. A key requirement is the ability to use AI effectively throughout your design process, from exploring concepts and creating assets to developing variations and speeding up production. You must be able to refine and quality-check the results, maintaining brand consistency and avoiding generic designs. Key responsibilities Design clear, engaging UX/UI for B2B service and e-commerce websites, including site structures, user journeys, wireframes and polished layouts. Create responsive designs for desktop, tablet and mobile. Design promotional and campaign landing pages that encourage enquiries, bookings and purchases. Create social media graphics, paid advertising creatives, website banners, email graphics and other digital marketing assets. Work with our SEO and content teams to create layouts that accommodate search-focused content, clear headings, internal links and useful navigation. Apply conversion principles, including clear calls to action, trust signals, readable content and straightforward enquiry or purchase journeys. Use AI tools to accelerate concept development, image creation and editing, asset production and design variations. Develop reusable components, templates and design systems to improve consistency and turnaround times. Prepare organised design files, specifications and assets for developers, and review implementation quality. Manage multiple client briefs, incorporate feedback and meet agreed deadlines. Proficiency in relevant image editing and graphic design tools. A solid understanding of typography, visual hierarchy, colour, spacing, accessibility and brand consistency. Clear English communication and the ability to collaborate with content, SEO, marketing and development teams. Familiarity with WordPress, Elementor and Shopify. Basic HTML/CSS knowledge and an understanding of development constraints. Experience creating motion graphics or short video creatives. Experience using performance data, user feedback or A/B testing to improve designs. How to apply Please send your CV and portfolio, including: Two or three relevant website or landing page projects, with a brief explanation of your contribution. Examples of social media or advertising creatives. At least one project showing how you used AI, which tools you used, what you refined yourself and how it improved delivery. Your availability and salary expectations. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short practical design task and walk us through their workflow. Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month Application Question(s): When can you join the company? What is your expected monthly salary in INR? Work Location: Remote

title: Software Engineer
description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. KLA is a global leader in process control and yield management solutions for the electronics and semiconductor industries. For decades, KLA has worked at the leading edge of deep science , taking on complex technical challenges that often take years to solve. By combining expertise in optics, sensors, machine learning, data analytics, and software engineering, KLA helps enable the ideas and devices that transform the future of technology. At KLA, innovation is driven by a belief that precision matters at the smallest scale —from nanometer‑level measurement to world‑class manufacturing quality. Our solutions support advanced manufacturing across wafers, integrated circuits, packaging, and printed circuit boards, making everyday technologies such as smartphones, data centers, autonomous systems, and connected devices possible. KLA fosters an engineering‑driven culture that values rigorous testing, continuous improvement, and collaboration across global teams. Software Quality Engineers at KLA contribute to products with real‑world impact while growing their careers in an environment that encourages curiosity, ownership, and long‑term technical excellence. The ICOS Division at KLA focuses on advanced optical inspection and metrology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, with strong emphasis on component inspection, wafer safety, and high‑precision optical systems . ICOS products play a critical role in ensuring manufacturing quality, yield, and reliability for leading semiconductor customers. ICOS products operate at the intersection of optics, mechanics, electronics, and software , making them inherently complex and quality‑sensitive. The division’s success depends not only on innovation in inspection capability, but also on robust system validation, safe operation, and predictable software behavior across diverse customer environments . Job Responsibilities Test Automation Engineer Understand the system and customer workflows end-to-end by analyzing product requirements, architecture, and real customer use cases; translate these into automation strategy and test coverage for web applications and web services. Participate early in the SDLC by reviewing functional/system requirements and designs to ensure testability , identify risks, and define measurable acceptance criteria aligned with user journeys and service/API contracts. Build and maintain a scalable test automation framework using Playwright (web UI automation) with strong engineering practices (reusable utilities, page/component patterns, stable selectors, test data strategy, reporting). Automate critical user flows (smoke, regression, and high-risk business paths) by modeling realistic user behavior and validating the complete workflow across UI, backend services, and data stores. Develop automated validations for Web Services / APIs (service-level functional checks, contract validation, negative testing, error handling) and integrate them with UI flows for true end-to-end quality coverage. Apply AI-assisted automation practices to improve reliability and maintenance efficiency (e.g., smarter test generation, adaptive/self-healing approaches, and AI-enabled test execution where applicable) to reduce script fragility and speed up automation development. Create and maintain test plans, automation suites, and execution pipelines to run on-demand and on schedule; ensure results are observable via dashboards/logs/reports and are usable for release decisions. Execute and monitor automated test runs across builds; analyze failures to distinguish product defects vs. test issues , improve stability, and keep the automation suite production-grade. Measure and communicate automation coverage, ROI, quality trends, and release risk ; continuously prioritize automation work based on defect trends and usage-critical paths. Collaborate with cross-functional and global stakeholders (developers, architects, product owners, system engineers) to improve testability and promote quality best practices throughout the lifecycle Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Software Engineering, Automation, Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field. Familiarity with software quality control processes and a good understanding of web UI testing concepts. Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as C/C++, Python, Perl, or VBScript. Experience with Visual Studio, automated testing frameworks, MySQL or Oracle databases, and Linux commands is preferred. Fluent in spoken and written English. Strong initiative, fast learning ability, proactive attitude, and excellent team spirit. Minimum Qualifications inimum Qualifications Master’s level degree with 0 years of related work experience, or bachelor’s level degree with a minimum of 2 years of related work experience. About KLA We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Work with a digital marketing company focused on measurable business growth. Recruit talented professionals across SEO, paid marketing, content, creative, and technology.
